title: 급여 명세서 읽기: 이번 달에 얼마를 받아요?
objective: You can read a Korean pay stub and find the payday, the deductions and the money that goes into your bank account.
summary: Learners read a Korean pay stub and find the payday, deductions and take-home pay.
note: The pay stub on this sheet uses a made-up name and example numbers.

task.title: Read and check pay stubs
task.line: Use the pay stub and word list on page 1 to find numbers, choose words and answer in Korean.

sections.heading: The pay stub
paragraphs: [공제 내역] 국민연금 110,000원 | 건강보험 85,000원 | 고용보험 20,000원 | 소득세 45,000원 | 지방소득세 4,500원 | 공제 합계 264,500원

items.text: This is the day the company pays you.
This is the fixed pay for your regular work.
This is extra money for things like night work or extra hours.
This is money for working more than your regular hours.
items.example: 이번 달에 일을 많이 해서 연장 근로 수당이 생겼어요.

items.text: This is money the company gives you for meals.
This is all the pay items added together before anything is taken out.
This is money taken out of your pay for tax and insurance.
This is the tax on the money you earn.
This is the money that actually goes into your bank account.

sections.heading: Reading tip
paragraphs: Find three numbers: 지급 합계 − 공제 합계 = 실수령액. The money in your bank account is the 실수령액, not the 지급 합계. -분 means 'for': 9월분 is the pay for September, and it can be paid in October.
국민연금 (national pension), 고용보험 (employment insurance) and 지방소득세 (local income tax) are also deductions.

exercises: Look at the pay stub on page 1 and answer in Korean: ① 김하늘 씨는 며칠에 월급을 받아요? ② 공제 합계는 얼마예요?
Choose the right word: 세금과 보험 때문에 월급에서 빠지는 돈이에요. (기본급 / 공제 / 식대)
Read the numbers and answer in Korean: 지급 합계 2,900,000원, 공제 합계 310,000원. 실수령액은 얼마예요?
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 매일 두 시간씩 더 일해서 이번 달에는 연장 근로 ____이 많아요.
Yes or No? Use the pay stub on page 1: ① 통장에 들어오는 돈은 지급 합계와 같아요. ② 9월분 급여는 9월에 일한 돈이에요. ③ 식대는 공제 내역에 있어요. ④ 소득세는 공제 내역에 있어요.
answers: ① No ② Yes ③ No ④ Yes
